subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should Telegram final-mode TTS suppress live text and bundle it into the voice caption by default through the new public channel capability, while the separate text-plus-voice preference remains a distinct product request?
rationale: The capability follows the repository's channel ownership boundary, but it changes existing visible delivery timing and establishes an extension-facing contract amid competing Telegram TTS UX preferences.

options.title: Approve capability and default
options.body: Accept the generic capability and Telegram opt-in after exact-head proof, while tracking separate delivery mode independently.

options.title: Preserve current default
options.body: Keep early visible text and require an explicit user delivery-mode setting before enabling deferred caption bundling.

options.title: Reject the public seam
options.body: Replace the extension-facing capability with a narrower owner-approved design if maintainers do not want this plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Approve capability and default
recommendation.body: Accept the generic capability and Telegram opt-in after exact-head proof, while tracking separate delivery mode independently.

likelyOwner.reason: The ACP dispatch history and central delivery-boundary work make this person the strongest available owner for the default-policy and API decision.
